units.source_text: 更衣身受皇上深恩重爱，然而贬斥她、诽谤她的人亦复不少。

en.t: The lady in waiting received the Emperor's deep favor and affection, yet there were also many people who belittled and slandered her.

units.source_text: 她身体羸弱，又没有外戚后援，因此皇上越是宠爱，她心中越是忧惧。

en.t: She was frail in health and had no powerful relatives to support her, so the more the Emperor loved her, the more anxious and afraid she became.
The palace residence where she lived was called the Kiritsubo.

units.source_text: 由此赴皇上常住的清凉殿，必须经过许多妃嫔的宫室。

en.t: To go from there to the Seiryo Hall, where the Emperor usually stayed, she had to pass through the quarters of many consorts.

units.source_text: 她不断地来来往往，别的妃嫔看在眼里怪不舒服，也是理所当然。

en.t: Since she was constantly going back and forth, it was only natural that the other consorts felt uncomfortable when they saw it.

units.source_text: 有时这桐壶更衣来往得过分频繁了，

en.t: At times, when this Kiritsubo lady in waiting came and went far too often,

units.source_text: 她们就恶意地作弄她，在板桥[\[4\]](#part1330.html#m4)上或过廊里放些龌龊东西，

en.t: they maliciously played tricks on her, placing filthy things on the plank bridge[\[4\]](#part1330.html#m4) or in the passageways,

units.source_text: 让迎送桐壶更衣的宫女们的衣裾弄得肮脏不堪。

en.t: so that the hems of the robes of the court ladies escorting Kiritsubo became terribly soiled.

units.source_text: 有时她们又彼此约通，把桐壶更衣所必须经过的走廊两头锁闭，

en.t: At other times, they conspired with one another and locked both ends of the corridor that Kiritsubo had to pass through,
causing her trouble and leaving her embarrassed and distressed.

units.source_text: 诸如此类，层出不穷，使得桐壶更衣痛苦万状。

en.t: Incidents like these occurred one after another, making the Kiritsubo lady in waiting suffer in every possible way.

units.source_text: 皇上看到此种情况，更加怜惜她，

en.t: When the Emperor saw this situation, he felt even greater pity for her,

units.source_text: 就教清凉殿后面后凉殿里的一个更衣迁到别处去，

en.t: and ordered one lady in waiting in the Koryo Hall behind the Seiryo Hall to move elsewhere,

units.source_text: 腾出房间来给桐壶更衣作值宿时的休息室。

en.t: freeing the room to serve as a resting chamber for Kiritsubo when she stayed overnight on duty.

units.source_text: 那个迁出外面去的更衣，更是怀恨无穷。

en.t: The lady in waiting who had been moved out bore an even deeper and endless resentment.
